body.zh-Hans: 本开发包使用原创合成、商业使用已获许可的非正典图像，专用于验证完整修复流程。
body.en: This development pack uses original synthetic, commercially cleared, non-Canon imagery solely to validate the complete restoration flow.

body.zh-Hans: 依次解读三种尺寸的彩色行列线索，让灯塔、信标与港湾色层重新连成一幅作品。
body.en: Read three sizes of colored line clues to reconnect the lighthouse, beacon, and harbor layers into one artwork.

body.zh-Hans: 完成全部片段后，可使用同一调色板的 15×15 拼豆蓝图制作最终合成作品。
body.en: After every Fragment is complete, use the matching-palette 15×15 bead Blueprint to make the final synthetic artifact.

body.zh-Hans: 数字表示连续色块长度；N、G、C 符号分别标记暮色蓝、灯塔金与港湾红。不同颜色可相邻，同色线段之间必须留空。教学不会写入作品进度。
body.en: Numbers give run lengths; N, G, and C identify dusk navy, beacon gold, and harbor coral. Different colors may touch, while same-color runs require a gap. Tutorial play never writes Artwork progress.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 从 5×5 到 15×15 的三段修复

body.zh-Hans: 可按任意顺序完成三个片段；每次完成都会独立保存，全部完成后解锁最终蓝图。
body.en: Complete the three Fragments in any order. Each completion saves independently, and finishing all three unlocks the final Blueprint.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 预览合成最终作品的材料规格
subtitle.en: Preview materials for the synthetic final artifact

body.zh-Hans: 查看 15×15 布局、三色材料数量与导出规格；修复室可随时进入。
body.en: Review the 15×15 layout, three-color material counts, and export specification; Restoration remains available at any time.

title.zh-Hans: 合成开发博物馆（非正典）

subtitle.zh-Hans: 原创合成开发馆藏 · 商业使用已获许可
subtitle.en: Original synthetic development collection · commercially cleared

body.zh-Hans: 此博物馆仅用于开发验证，不代表真实机构、艺术家或历史馆藏。
body.en: This Museum exists only for development validation and represents no real institution, artist, or historical collection.

body.zh-Hans: 三段由左至右的修复区域共同组成灯塔与港湾信号。
body.en: Three left-to-right restoration regions jointly form a lighthouse and harbor signal.

title.zh-Hans: 暮色港湾信号（合成开发作品，非正典）
title.en: Dusk Harbor Signal (Synthetic Development Artwork, Non-Canon)

subtitle.zh-Hans: 原创合成开发资产 · 无真实艺术家声明
subtitle.en: Original synthetic development asset · no real artist claim

body.zh-Hans: 左、中、右三个互不重叠的区域完整划分画面，并以同一三色调色板逐步呈现灯塔轮廓。
body.en: Distinct left, center, and right regions fully partition the image and progressively reveal a lighthouse silhouette in one three-color palette.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 三个片段均已归档；15×15 合成最终作品蓝图与材料清单现已解锁。
completionBody.en: All three Fragments are archived; the 15×15 synthetic final-artifact Blueprint and material list are now unlocked.

subtitle.zh-Hans: 5×5 彩色 Nonogram · 教学参考

body.zh-Hans: 用三种颜色勾勒灯塔、灯光与港湾基线。
body.en: Outline the lighthouse, its light, and the harbor baseline in three colors.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 此区域已独立归档；无论它在三个片段中第几个完成，整体进度都会正确更新。
completionBody.en: This region is archived independently; overall progress updates correctly regardless of when it is completed among the three Fragments.

body.zh-Hans: 扩展塔身、信标与港湾反光，形成清晰的中型信号图。
body.en: Extend the tower, beacon, and harbor reflection into a clear medium signal image.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 此区域已独立归档；完成顺序不会改变文案、保存结果或其余片段状态。
completionBody.en: This region is archived independently; completion order does not change its copy, saved result, or the state of other Fragments.

body.zh-Hans: 完成具有塔身、金色信标与珊瑚色港面的最终高分辨率图案。
body.en: Complete the final high-resolution pattern with tower, golden beacon, and coral harbor surface.

completionBody.zh-Hans: 此区域已独立归档；系统按已完成片段总数计算进度，不假定它是最后完成。
completionBody.en: This region is archived independently; progress uses the completed-Fragment count and never assumes this one finishes last.
